W_order_spec_keeps_its_own_lf_only_regex._note: Ratchet site, no work item of its own. Pre-fix a CRLF-fenced order-spec asset was invisible, so the vault's canonical frontmatter ordering was silently not applied to anything `create`/`apply` wrote. Narrow by construction: E2 is the only axis that loads an order spec. ⛤ E3 (the ratchet) reddens under this mutant AND under every other WIRING mutant of this work item, and that was NOT in the first prediction — it was derived from the mutant's THEME rather than from which axes EXECUTE after it lands (integration-test-revert-verify §A44). The reason is structural and is good news: each WIRING mutant re-introduces the literal `/^---\n` into `packages/cli/src`, which is exactly the form E3 asserts is extinct. So E3 is a live ratchet with a demonstrated flip, not a pin — it would be satisfiable by a broken grep otherwise, and its own canary only proves the predicate, not that anything can trip it.
